content: We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly the compound is the sample at hand; we can get NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons. Could also retrieve carbon shifts ranges but need actual data. Likely we need to use carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get 13C NMR, then count aromatic carbon signals (around 120-150 ppm). Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
